fact: In 2024 technical tests connecting Burundi's RTGS to EAPS (with the Bank of Tanzania) and to COMESA REPSS were suspended for the ISO 20022 migration begun in August 2024, with production projected before end December 2025, and no PAPSS integration activity took place in 2024.
title: Rapport annuel sur les systèmes et moyens de paiement et leur surveillance, Exercice 2024
publisher: Banque de la République du Burundi
